source_text: Organizations advocating genital autonomy, such as the Australasian Institute for Genital Autonomy, argue this violates children's bodily integrity, equating it morally to prohibited female genital cutting and citing UN Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC) Articles 19 and 24 against harmful traditional practices performed without therapeutic necessity.
